approval_note: all: every Short waits for Charlie's OK; flagged: only Shorts with a reason to look wait (the end goal); none: everything uploads straight away.
note: Three writer runs a day (see runs): 20:50 writes the first part of tomorrow, 06:50 and 12:50 write from the day's trends. daily_limit is Shorts made per day, slots_per_day how many go public a day (07:30 to 22:50 every 40 minutes until learned slots take over), upload_limit_24h how many uploads GitHub attempts in 24 hours. The channel has YouTube's Advanced features; if YouTube refuses an upload for its limit, the Short waits and the next run retries. The YouTube Data API allows about 100 uploads a day.
tiktok_note: off (Charlie, 19 Oct 2026): TikTok blocked every post as spam and its Creator Rewards only pay for videos over a minute, so nothing goes there. inbox: the day's 5 TikTok picks land in the TikTok phone app as drafts once scheduled, and Charlie posts them with the captions from his TikTok queue page; manual: he uploads them himself; direct: posts by itself (needs TikTok's review).
instagram_note: all: every Short goes to Instagram once public on YouTube, the day's picks first, at most a ramped number in 24 hours: instagram_per_day to start, +instagram_ramp_per_day for each day since the first Reel, up to instagram_target (Meta allows 100 API posts a day; it blocked our API access once, so the ramp is gentle). Shorts public for more than crosspost_max_age_hours are skipped. picks: only the day's picks.
reserve_note: Evergreen Shorts in boards/reserve fill any of the day's slots the writer runs left empty: after reserve_after (UK), up to reserve_per_day a day. In flagged approval mode a reserve Short with nothing flagged needs no approval; a flagged one waits for a 'reserve approve' line.
runs_note: Shorts each writer run makes. evening (20:50) writes the first part of TOMORROW (created = tomorrow, slots from 07:30) so flagged ones can be approved before bed; morning (06:50) and afternoon (12:50) write from that day's fresh trends.
crosspost_youtube_line: New every day on YouTube: Quickplay Daily
facebook_note: Facebook Page Reels (GitHub secrets FB_PAGE_TOKEN and FB_PAGE_ID): every Short once public on YouTube, picks first, ramped like Instagram (Meta allows 30 API Reels per Page per 24 hours).
